consequence.statement: The wireguard.userspaceFallback Helm value is no longer honoured; WireGuard transparent encryption now requires a Linux kernel with WireGuard support and will not fall back to userspace mode.
consequence.remediation: Remove the wireguard.userspaceFallback setting from your Helm values. Ensure your Linux kernel has WireGuard support enabled before upgrading.

original.statement: The previously deprecated Helm value wireguard.userspaceFallback has been removed in Cilium 1.17.0.

decision.reason: [ev-ffd2c3200e89] lists wireguard.userspaceFallback under "Removed Options" and says it "has been removed" and that WireGuard users "are required to use a Linux kernel with WireGuard support". So a configured value stops being honoured and the userspace fallback is gone, which fits setting-ignored (action) rather than a changed default. The evidence doesn't say what severity this has, and it doesn't say what fails on kernels without WireGuard support, so "high" is a judgement call and workload-failure isn't claimed. Separately, the values validator found the key in neither chart's default values [ev-28e0ccb5774a, ev-39a22d88e2f5], which casts doubt on the subject, hence low confidence.
